diagnostic_method: Projected top-disk masks eroded one pixel; outer-ring mask excludes an expanded pit. Summarize continuous raw RGB differences under the existing fixed threshold; no alternative acceptance threshold or repeated capture.
interpretation: The outer dent ring is rendered at the expected location and extent, while its interior raw channel difference is uniformly 14 and therefore excluded by the unchanged >20 validation mask. The central pit difference is 77. This failure exposes a low-contrast limitation of the pixel validation assumption; it is not a missing/full-frame scene or oversized geometry error.
limitations: Pixel masks approximate rasterized top faces; cylinder side walls and antialiasing are excluded from interior contrast summaries.
This diagnostic does not turn a failed acquisition into passing evidence or authorize reuse of the partial dataset.
No real-world realism or trained-model generalization is measured.
acquisition_decision: FAIL retained; preserve the partial acquisition and associated r2 assets. No retry, threshold change or favorable-image selection.
proposed_revision_scope: A separately versioned, class-independent high-contrast surface-proxy material domain; all scene conditions sampled without reference to pixel outcomes, with low-contrast r2 evidence retained as unsupported/OOD.
